fightSong.title: Smoke and Rockets
fightSong.lyrics: Brisket smoking, rockets glowing / Houston power, watch us going / Low and slow to outer space / Spaceships winning every race!

stadium.name: The Launch Pit
stadium.tradition: The Brisket Burn — a 1,000-pound smoker shaped like a Saturn V is lit 12 hours before kickoff. Astronauts (real ones) serve the first slice.

fanCulture.description: They wear cowboy hats with NASA patches. After touchdowns they do the 'moonwalk two-step.' It's Houston, it's weird, it works.
fanCulture.tailgate: Brisket at 5am, because space waits for no one.

rivalries.name: The Texas Two-Step
rivalries.narrative: Cowboys vs astronauts. They ride bulls, we ride rockets.

paAnnouncer.firstDownCall: First down Houston! That's a successful launch!
paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: SPACESHIP TOUCHDOWN! Houston, we have six!

cityFlavor: Space City meets Smoke City. We put a man on the moon and brisket in your soul.
